title: Job Fair
summary: A Job Fair was organized on 22nd August 2026 at SPDT College, Andheri East, with the Rotary Club of Bombay Airport serving as the lead host.
description: A Job Fair was organized on 22nd August 2026 at SPDT College, Andheri East, with the Rotary Club of Bombay Airport serving as the lead host. The initiative received over 1,325 registrations from young job seekers seeking entry-level employment opportunities, while 27 companies participated in the interview and recruitment process. The project was spearheaded by PP Rajesh Agarwal in collaboration with the Vedanta Foundation and other participating Rotary Clubs. The fair created a valuable platform for young people to directly interact with reputed employers, submit their CVs, and explore employment opportunities that may otherwise have been inaccessible to them. The initiative demonstrated the importance of focused vocational service in bridging the gap between young job seekers and potential employers.
location: SPDT College, Andheri East, Mumbai, Maharashtra
